# Code of Conduct

Sekhemet's community — its issues, discussions, pull requests and every other space the project runs — follows the **[Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/)**. By taking part, you agree to it.

In short:

- **Be respectful and welcoming,** to people of every background and level of experience. Beginners are part of who Sekhemet is for.
- **Disagree about ideas, not people.** Give and take criticism of work constructively.
- **Not acceptable:** harassment, insults, sexualised language or imagery, personal or political attacks, publishing someone's private information without their permission, and any conduct that would be inappropriate in a professional setting.

The full text, which governs, is at the link above.

## Reporting

Report behaviour that breaks this code to the maintainer, Brennan Kelley, privately, through the contact on the maintainer's GitHub profile, [github.com/brennansk1](https://github.com/brennansk1). Reports are read only by the maintainer and kept confidential. Do not report conduct in a public issue.

## Enforcement

The maintainer reviews every report and may take any action the Contributor Covenant 2.1's enforcement guidelines describe, from a private correction or a warning to a temporary or permanent ban from the project's spaces, depending on what happened and its impact.

This code of conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1, licensed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
